steps.name: Hallmark pathway enrichment on treated vs control DE ranks
steps.question: Which of the 50 MSigDB hallmark pathways are significantly enriched among genes ranked by their differential expression in the atopic dermatitis lesional (treated) vs control skin contrast?
acceptance_criteria: Loads /eval-full-32-without-python-enrichment-only-1/data/inputs/results/de_results.csv (12000 genes x 8 cols) and constructs a rank metric per gene (e.g. sign(log2_fold_change) * -log10(pvalue), dropping genes with missing/duplicate symbols or NA statistics)
Loads the MSigDB human hallmark GMT (50 HALLMARK_* sets, HGNC symbols) from the reference store, confirming the file resolves before running
Runs gseapy prerank (or equivalent) on the full ranked gene list against the hallmark sets with a fixed random seed and reports NES, p-value, and FDR q-value per hallmark pathway
Outputs a full results table (all 50 hallmark pathways with NES/FDR) sorted by significance, and separately flags pathways passing FDR < 0.05
Explicitly reports genes from de_results.csv that failed to map to a hallmark set member and the fraction of the ranked list actually used

steps.name: Summarize and visualize top enriched hallmark pathways
steps.question: Which hallmark pathways are most strongly up- or down-regulated in AD lesional versus control skin, and how confident is each call?
acceptance_criteria: Consumes the T1S1 pre-ranked GSEA output table (NES, p-value, FDR per hallmark pathway)

Produces a ranked bar plot or dot plot of hallmark pathways ordered by NES, colored by direction (up in lesional vs up in control), restricted to FDR < 0.25 (standard GSEA significance threshold) with FDR < 0.05 called out separately
Writes a plain-language summary table listing pathway name, NES, FDR, and leading-edge gene count for each significant hallmark pathway
States explicitly if no hallmark pathway reaches FDR < 0.25, rather than reporting nominal p-value hits as significant

plan.title: AD lesional vs control hallmark pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: The DE table already provides the treated (AD lesional) vs control DESeq2 contrast (12000 genes x 8 columns including gene, base_mean, log2_fold_change, and adjusted p-value). Rather than re-run differential expression, this plan starts directly from that results table, builds a ranking metric (signed -log10(p) x log2FC or the Wald statistic if present) and runs pre-ranked GSEA against the MSigDB human hallmark gene set collection (50 curated sets, HGNC symbols) staged in the reference store. A single enrichment step is sufficient given the compact, already-processed DE input; a second step formats and visualizes the top enriched hallmark pathways (up/down in lesional skin) for reporting. All code is Python (gseapy for pre-ranked GSEA), per the user's constraint.
